title: WELL photo gallery for Mahesh Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life' (ug_1.htm index)
host: people.well.com (The WELL, user jct = J.C. Tuttle? / 'Essential UG')
description: Main photo index of the online edition of Mahesh Bhatt's biography (Penguin India 1992, '20 photographs'); plates scanned by Sajid Martin. Captions include 1945 with wife Kusuma and daughter Bharati (plate 1-9); Pebble Beach CA with Parveen Babi (1-12); New York 1983 with Parveen Babi and Valentine (1-14); Gstaad. Known sub-pages: bphotos/ug_1.htm, bphotos/ph2.htm, bphotos/ug_n_son.htm, bphotos/val_ol~2.htm. Copyright: Penguin/Mahesh Bhatt plates reproduced with the book's text; no explicit licence.

title: WELL photo page: U.G. with children Bharati, Vasant and Usha (ph2.htm / ug_n_son.htm)
description: Second photo index (plates 2-x) from the A Life gallery; includes the children Bharati, Vasant and Usha (plate 2-9) and 'UG and son' page (ug_n_son.htm, also at old URL www.well.com/~jct/bphotos/ug_n_son.htm). Only captions were confirmed via search; images not viewed.

title: WELL photo page: Valentine de Kerven (val_ol~2.htm)
description: Gallery page devoted to Valentine de Kerven: as a young woman and with U.G. in Bangalore and Amsterdam (plates 2-7, 1-13, 1-14). Part of the A Life scans.

title: Wikimedia Commons: File:UGKrishnamurti.jpg
description: Small portrait, author credited as Giuliano Sauro, licence GFDL, uploaded 2007. Appears in Category:Uppaluri_Gopala_Krishnamurti (which carries Wikidata Q423541 authority data). Category '20th-century philosophers from India' says 2 files for UG; the second file was not surfaced by search.

title: Mahesh Bhatt on X: tribute post with UG photo (5 Sept 2017)
description: 'U.G. Krishnamurti....The man who built & shaped my life. The man who in his hours of death gave me a taste of life!!!' with attached photo (t.co/YJSuyKmINY). Also 2015 post announcing Tamil edition of A Life: https://x.com/MaheshNBhatt/status/579607713191198720. No Mahesh Bhatt Instagram UG post found by search.

title: Instagram account @u.g.krishnamurti
description: Fan/quotes account: 784 followers, 0 following, 33 posts (as indexed). Operator unknown.

title: Parveen Babi with U.G. Krishnamurti photos (Pebble Beach; New York 1983)
description: Provenance: both images are plates from Mahesh Bhatt's A Life (Penguin India 1992), captioned 'In Pebble Beach, California, with Parveen Babi' (1-12) and 'In New York, in 1983, with Parveen Babi and Valentine' (1-14). Babi flew to New York with UG and Valentine on 30 July 1983 (Wikipedia). WikiBio page reproduces one ('U. G. Krishnamurti With Parveen Babi') without credit. Scroll.in 2017 piece on the Babi material omitted from the UG comic biography.

title: Julie Thayer photographs of UG (300+ photographs; videographer of The Natural State)
description: Thayer states in Travels with UG / Get Lost and Stay Lost that she took 'well over 300 photographs' of UG; ugunplugged blog (Apr 2017) names Wendy Moorty and Julie Clark Thayer as the two great photographers of UG. Her camcorder footage (1989-2007) is the core of the 2026 film The Natural State. No formal exhibition or photo book found.

title: The Natural State (2026, dir. Matthew Dougherty) - festival stills and listings
place: Telluride CO; Saugerties NY (Woodstock FF); Upstate Films
host: deadline.com; upstatefilms.org; thefilmstage.com; awfj.org; nextbestpicture.com; varietyindia.com; theoverlooknews.com
description: World premiere Telluride FF Sept 2026 (exec. producers Jane Campion, Mahesh Bhatt); Woodstock FF screening Sat 17 Oct 2026, Orpheum Theatre Saugerties; Upstate Films lists USA 2026, 99 min. Deadline interview carries a still of UG and Thayer credited 'Sine Altera'. No official poster found in search; Overlook News story on the Hudson Valley WhatsApp group that helped the film.

title: Redbubble 'U.G. Krishnamurti' photographic print by user ugkrishnamurti
description: Print-on-demand reproduction of a UG photo sold by Redbubble seller 'ugkrishnamurti' (item 59755035). Copyright status of the underlying photo unverified.

title: Pinterest board 'i love U.G... and jiddu krishnamurti' (prakasamk)
description: Pinterest board with ~100 pins of UG photos and quotes (mixed with J. Krishnamurti pins).

title: Heart of Yoga blog: UG with Mark Whitwell, TKV Desikachar, Melissa Forbes
description: Photos of UG with Mark Whitwell and TKV Desikachar at Krishnamacharya's site, and with Melissa Forbes. Mark Whitwell interview on UG also at markwhitwell.medium.com.

title: ugkrishnamurti.net - main UG website (full texts of books)
description: Listed by Narayana Moorty (narayanamoorty.net) as UG's main website; Dharmapedia says most published works by and about UG can be read freely there. Operator not confirmed by search. Companion .org described by Moorty as a 'photos and quotes' site.

title: ugkrishnamurti.org - photos and quotes site (status uncertain)
description: Narayana Moorty's links page describes .org as a photos-and-quotes site; Dharmapedia lists .org as 'the website'. Operator (Raj Mehta / Essential UG?) NOT confirmed; search for 'Essential UG Raj Mehta' returned nothing. Wayback snapshot range not retrievable without fetch - still open.

title: ugkrishnamurti.in - 'The Revolutionary Spiritual Teacher' site with Resources & Archive
description: Modern site with sections 'resources-and-archive' and 'resources-and-archive/book-about-ug'; lists a contact email. Operator not identified by search. A photo-gallery page was not surfaced.

title: Essential UG - U.G. Krishnamurti Streaming Video Archive (WELL, index_main.html)
description: 'Essential UG' streaming archive hosted on The WELL (same jct user as the biography). Lists talks such as 1995 Yercaud talk and 'You are a Parrot'. Older resource, links may be dead. This confirms 'Essential UG' is the WELL jct site, not necessarily ugkrishnamurti.org.

title: Internet Archive collection: 'U.G. Krishnamurti conversations and interviews - audio' (ugkrishnamurti-audio)
description: Collection identifier ugkrishnamurti-audio, creator Jeff Kaplan, ~80 items. Item IDs include ug_ug_w_mb (audio of TV conversation with Mahesh Bhatt; video id ug_ug_w_mb_150), ug_ug_parapsy (Dimensions in Parapsychology with Bryce Bond), ug_living_in_your_own_world, ug_guest_of_the_week_bbc_radio, ug_new_dimensions_19891114, ug_what_is_going_on_here_is_sa, ug_ug_with_unknown_individual, ug_there_is_no_such_thing_as_ultimate_reality. Status: public uploads; no explicit licence.

title: this robot dreaming blog: 'U. G. Krishnamurti tapes' (cassettes 1967-1990s uploaded to Internet Archive)
description: Blog author announces uploading all their UG cassette tapes (1967 to 1990s) converted to MP3 to the Internet Archive with a 'listen here' link. Exact archive.org item IDs not surfaced by search - still open.

title: Internet Archive text items: UGKrishnamurtiTheCourageToStandAlone; UGKrishnamurtiStoppedInOurTracks227p; mindismythconver0000kris
description: Courage to Stand Alone (Amsterdam 1982 conversations; tapes by Henk Schonewille) in opensource collection; Stopped In Our Tracks 227p scan; Mind is a Myth library scan (mindismythconver0000kris, controlled lending).

title: Smriti Books (New Delhi) UG titles
description: Smriti Books, 124 Siddhartha Enclave, New Delhi 110014 (not Bangalore). UG titles: Mind Is a Myth (2003, dist. New Age Books); God Men Con Men (Robert Carr, 2003); Stopped in Our Tracks (K. Chandrasekhar, ed. Moorty, 2005, ISBN 8187967765); Mystique of Enlightenment (2005, ISBN 9788187967095); Courage to Stand Alone. Open Library lists 16 works for the publisher. Bangalore UG publishers: Sowmya Publishers (Thought Is Your Enemy, 1990), Akshaya Publications (No Way Out).

title: Italian Facebook group 'U.G. in italiano' (Pierluigi Piazza) and riflessioni.it Italian pages
description: riflessioni.it hosts an Italian translation of a 1995 Rome interview and points to a Facebook group dedicated to UG curated by Pierluigi Piazza. Italian books: L'Inganno dell'Illuminazione (Re Nudo Edizioni; review at piloton.it/libri/ug.html); famigliafideus.com PDF 'Interviste a U.G. Krishnamurti'. Group URL/size not surfaced.

title: Dutch editions: De moed om te zijn wie je bent (Amsterdam 1982 gesprekken); De denkbeeldige geest
description: Dutch translations surfaced via Amazon.it author listing. Italian Wikipedia notes translations exist in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Polish, Serbian, Korean, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Italian. No dedicated German/Dutch UG website found.

title: X/Twitter account @krishnamurtiug
description: Quotes account named 'U. G. Krishnamurti'. Follower count not surfaced.

title: Facebook page 'U G Krishnamurti' (ugknowayout)
description: Facebook page; links to ugkrishnamurti.net. Size not surfaced.

title: Narayana Moorty's Philosophy Page (narayanamoorty.net) - links hub
description: Narayana Moorty's site; links to ugkrishnamurti.net (main site) and .org (photos and quotes). Moorty co-edited Stopped in Our Tracks.

title: Imgflip tag page 'ug krishnamurti 1918-2007' (memes)
description: Imgflip tag listing of UG memes, incl. a demotivational-maker image by user JohnRogers1. User-generated; no licence.

title: Wikipedia language editions with infoboxes: Kannada, Telugu, Gujarati, Marathi, Italian
description: Articles exist: kn 'ಯು. ಜಿ. ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ'; te 'ఉప్పులూరి గోపాలకృష్ణ మూర్తి' (infobox lists granddaughter Soumya Bollapragada); gu 'યુ.જી.કૃષ્ણમુર્તિ'; mr 'यू.जी. कृष्णमूर्ती'; it 'Uppaluri Gopala Krishnamurti'. No Hindi article surfaced. Which infobox image each uses (Commons UGKrishnamurti.jpg vs other) NOT verified - still open.

title: u-g-k.fr - French UG site (WordPress) with uploaded biography PDF (2025)
description: French-language WordPress site u-g-k.fr; hosts a PDF 'U.G. Krishnamurti Born 9 July 1918 Machilipatnam...' uploaded July 2025. Operator and full contents not identified.

title: Remembering U. G. Krishnamurti blog: Talks, Passages, Photos, E-Books and Videos
description: Blogspot collection 'Remembering U. G. Krishnamurti: A collection of his Talks, Quotes, Audiobooks, Photos and Videos'. Lists videos incl. Talk at Yercaud 1995, Mill Valley talks, Willem de Ridder interview. Photo posts not individually surfaced.

title: UG Archive blog (ugarchive.blogspot.com)
description: Blogspot fan archive of UG material; contents not detailed in search.

title: 'UG the enigma...' fan blog (ugunplugged.blogspot.com) - photo credits to Wendy Moorty and Julie Thayer
description: Blog posts 2017; April 2017 post states Wendy Moorty and Julie Clark Thayer 'are both great photographers and have given us some of the most wonderful pictures of UG'. August 2017 archive also indexed.

title: UGK Quotes Roulette (ugkquotesroulette.com) - all quotes list
description: Random-quote web app with page listing every UG quote used. Secondary source.

title: Internet Archive video item 'U.G. at Yercaud' (ug_yercaud95)
description: 1995 discussion video, Yercaud, India; catalogued under UG conversations and interviews (Kaplan uploads). Fan archives list it at ~12 min.

title: Louis Brawley: Instagram @louisbrawley (1,911 posts), WordPress blog, planned UG photo book
description: Brawley (photographer/artist, UG's companion 2002-07, author of Goner, Non-Duality Press 2011) has Instagram with 1,911 posts tagged incl. 'Goner'; in a 2011 blog comment he said he was working on 'another one with photographs and writing' but production cost made release uncertain. Site louisbrawley.com. No published UG photo set confirmed.

title: Narayana Moorty's Blog Page (moortysblogpage.blogspot.com): 'Notable Travels and Visits -- Times Spent with UG' (2009)
description: March 2009 memoir post: UG photographing the group at Mount Egli; Wendy (Moorty) following UG taking pictures in Lalbagh gardens, Bangalore; describes Chalet Sunbeam (two-storey, landlord Herr Grossman upstairs); mentions a dispute over photographs and videos of UG collected by Chandrasekhar. Photos embedded not confirmed.

title: Facebook page 'U.G.Krishnamurti' (@ugkrishnamurtime) - 7,657 followers
description: Largest indexed UG Facebook page, 7,657 followers (as indexed 2026). Operator unknown.

title: Facebook group 'Friends of UG Krishnamurti' (URL and size unconfirmed)
description: Only evidence: 2016 comment by 'hugo alex' on spiritualteachers.org recommending Facebook group 'friends of UG Krishnamurti' with 'a lot of interesting posts'. Group URL/member count not surfaced by search. Contact ugkfriends@gmail.com listed on ugkrishnamurti.in.

title: UG Aradhana - annual Friends-of-UG gathering, 22 March, 'Hridaya Vihar', Bangalore (hosts K. Chandrasekhar & Suguna)
description: Annual death-anniversary meet in Bangalore at the home of Chandrasekhar and Suguna: 4th UG Aradhana 22 March 2011 (blog 26 Mar 2011), 11th on 22 March 2018 (post with photo captions). Framed as 'for the friends, not for UG'. Only source: sulochanosho.wordpress.com. No 9 July birthday gathering found.

title: YouTube: 'Friends of UG Krishnamurti, A Film By Bob Carr.. Part 1' and 'West Coast Friends Gathering'
description: Two community videos: Bob (Robert) Carr's film 'Friends of UG Krishnamurti' Part 1; 'U.G. Krishnamurti - West Coast Friends Gathering' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9kYx9e-lZA8). Dates/uploaders not surfaced.

title: Chalet Sunbeam, Gstaad - summer residence (c. 25 summers); textual sources, no dedicated photos found
description: Rented chalet in Gstaad; two storeys, landlord Herr Grossman and wife upstairs (Moorty); lawn overlooking Gstaad tennis courts (Friedrich Grohe newsletter Fall 1993); one visitor recalls an afternoon in the Chalet Sunbeam garden in 1976; Bhatt's 'A Taste of Death' recounts a 30-day stay, summer 1995 (ug-k.blogspot.com). No photo of the chalet itself surfaced - still open.

title: Vallecrosia (Liguria) - place of death 22 March 2007; no plaque/villa photo found
description: Died 2.30 pm 22 Mar 2007 at a friend's villa in Vallecrosia after 7 weeks bedridden following a fall; cremated next day by Mahesh Bhatt without rituals (Oneindia 24 Mar 2007 spells 'Vallecorsia'). Italian searches for a targa/plaque returned nothing. Related: Mahesh Bhatt, A Taste of Life: The Last Days of U.G. Krishnamurti (Penguin, ISBN 9780143067160; audiobook).

title: Poornakutee, Bangalore - UG's residence; Valentine de Kerven died there; no photos found
description: Poornakutee referenced throughout Stopped in Our Tracks (Wikisource; WELL sitpariv.htm; u-g-krishnamurti.blogspot.com 2007 posts incl. Valentine de Kerven's death there). No photograph of the house surfaced - still open.

title: Machilipatnam / Gudivada - birthplace; no memorial or memorial house found
description: Born Machilipatnam 9 July 1918, raised in Gudivada by Theosophist lawyer grandfather; some sources (imeuswe) give Gudivada as birthplace. UG asked for no rituals or remembrance. No memorial, plaque or trust surfaced. Family-tree page: imeuswe.in/famous-families/Uppaluri-Krishnamurti.

title: No UG Krishnamurti trust / centre / foundation in India found
description: Searches for a UG trust, centre or foundation returned only J. Krishnamurti foundations (excluded). Closest: ugkrishnamurti.in (contact ugkfriends@gmail.com); Bangalore/Mysore small publishers Akshaya Publications (Alla Guruji, 1995; No Way Out) and Sowmya Publications (Mysore 1999; Thought Is Your Enemy 1990).

title: Forum threads: Dharma Overground, Actualized.org, Dhamma Wheel, ligotti.net
description: Dharma Overground 'U.G. Krishnamurti !' (thorjackson; replies 2008-2018). Actualized.org: 'Making sense of U.G Krishnamurti' (topic 93007) and Part 2 (101055), 'Mind is a Myth' (38320), 'What Thinking Is?' (92738), 'You're a seeking fool' (15368). Dhamma Wheel 'The Dharma Seals of a Non-Buddhist' (t=30425). Thomas Ligotti Online 'U.G. Krishnamurti R.I.P.' (threads/1098, 2007). Nothing from philosophynow, sciforums, tmswiki, Genius Forums surfaced.

title: Google Groups noshonuts: 'Critique of U.G. Krishnamurti' (David Quinn) and 'Swan Song of UG' (c. 2007, poster sulochanosho)
description: Two ~2007 threads posted by sulochanosho: David Quinn's hostile critique and a Swan Song excerpt. Group size/activity not shown.

title: Quora questions on U.G. Krishnamurti (no topic page surfaced)
description: Individual questions: sayings; people like UG; thoughts; 'Was UG a fraud?'; thoughts come from outside; belief in God; meditation as violence; 'unrational'; JK vs UG on meditation. Answer quality mixed.

title: Substack / Medium essays on UG: professordeino.substack.com; sureshn13 (Suresh N) on Medium incl. Uma Balaji guest article; Mark Whitwell on Medium
description: Substack essay 'U.G. Krishnamurti's Tittle and the Mystique of Enlightenment' (critical). Medium: 'Who is UG Krishnamurti. The Provocative Iconoclast' and 'My Journey With UG Krishnamurti' (guest, Uma Balaji) by sureshn13; Mark Whitwell 'My Life with U.G. Krishnamurti' and interview parts. NOTE: 'The Observing I' (theobservingi.com, David Johnson) is a general philosophy podcast/Substack with no UG content found - not a UG newsletter.

title: Public-domain-style ebook reissues: e-artnow (2021, 2023), Sharp Ink (2023), DigiCat (2022), Good Press (2020)
description: e-artnow: The Essential Works of U.G. Krishnamurti (26 Mar 2021, ASIN B0919M185Z; Apple Books id1560620030), The Teachings of U.G. Krishnamurti: Collected Works (27 Mar 2021, B0919NQ5Q6; Storytel ISBN 4064066383053), Collected Works Annotated (11 Dec 2023, ISBN 4066339572539); e-artnow paperbacks The Natural State ISBN 9788027341504 (112pp), Mystique 9788027341443 (100pp). Sharp Ink: U.G. Krishnamurti: Collected Works (12 Sep 2023, 1116pp, EAN 9788028311636; Everand 21 Feb 2023). DigiCat Courage to Stand Alone 2022; Good Press Dec 2020. Rights status unverified; texts circulate as 'copyright-free' per UG's declaration.

title: Book covers located: Sentient Publications (Mystique 9780971078611; Mind Is a Myth 9781591810650, 2007); HarperCollins India Biology of Enlightenment (2010, 9789350290095); Penguin A Taste of Life (9780143067160)
description: Cover images available on publisher/retailer pages: Sentient Publications (dist. Simon & Schuster) Mystique of Enlightenment 159pp and Mind Is a Myth 165pp (10 Sep 2007); HarperCollins India The Biology of Enlightenment ed. Mukunda Rao 2010 (430/448pp; 2015 reprint) at AbeBooks/Indigo/Open Library; Penguin India A Taste of Life (Bhatt). Bhatt's memoir cover uses a b/w photo of Bhatt and UG (ThePrint excerpt). Covers for The Other Side of Belief (Penguin 2005?), Sage and the Housewife (Shanta Kelker; exoticindiaart listing), Penguin UG Reader (occultnthings listing), German Das Denken ist dein Feind (2016 Taschenbuch, eBay.de), Italian L'Inganno dell'Illuminazione (Re Nudo) found only as retailer listings.

title: 2007 death coverage: The Hindu 'U.G. Krishnamurti passes away'; Oneindia; cuke.com; WELL 'Remembering UG'; Scribd 'The death of UG'
description: The Hindu today's-paper item (URL cited in a reader comment; not opened); Oneindia 24 Mar 2007 report; cuke.com death-and-dying page; WELL Final_Remembering.htm; Scribd doc 922484847. No Guardian/Independent/Telegraph obituary and no credited obituary photograph surfaced - still open.

title: Sat Sangha Salon (o-meditation.com): UG books and audios download page
description: Aggregator page offering UG books and audio downloads, plus profile page 'More Masters, Mystics and Misfits'. Also holybooks.com PDF of Thought Is Your Enemy and inner-quest.org Natural State page.

title: WELL (people.well.com/user/jct) ancillary pages: lists.html bibliography, links.htm, mahesh.html, Stopped in Our Tracks, ugbio chapters
description: Bibliography 'Books, Interviews, and References', links page, Mahesh Bhatt page, full text of A Life (ugbio/ugbtitle.htm, ugbio4.htm) and Stopped in Our Tracks (SIT/part_ii.htm, sitpaiii.htm, sitpariv.htm).

title: Podcasts featuring Louis Brawley on UG: Buddha at the Gas Pump #177; Hermitix 'Anti-Guru, Barking Dog'
description: BATGAP episode 177 interview; Hermitix podcast episode (also on YouTube cAbYSatRje4). YouTube Hindi video 'The Guru Who Changed Mahesh Bhatt's Life' (3Y7EZ9sBZYs).

title: Dharmapedia wiki entry and Wikidata Q423541 (authority IDs: ISNI, VIAF, GND, LoC)
description: Wikidata item lists sitelinks and authority control; Dharmapedia mirror article lists ugkrishnamurti.org as website and says most works readable free online.
